history.content: How can I cash out a check internationally?

You can cash US checks in almost any decent bank anywhere in the world. The easiest options appear to be to open an account with one of the large multinational banks. For example, a bank like Citi may be able to help you cash the check. Citi in particular has an international account that appears to make mutli-currency personal banking easier.
I see. Now I want to create an account with Citi bank. that sounds beneficial to me

Unfortunately, you will not be able to have "standard" account with Citibank, but you will the "plus" account option. It will require you a minimum monthly deposit of 1,800 sterling and two direct debits.
never mind. I can not do that. but I still need cash to shop though..
Please remember that paying in physical cash is almost never a good idea for large purchases. However, you can try to use ATM instead of trying to cash out a check.
can I use ATM internationally as well?

Yes, you can use ATMs internationally to withdraw cash. However, you should be aware that your bank may charge ATM withdrawal fees and there might be a surcharge imposed by the foreign ATM, as is the case with Thai ATMs that impose a surcharge of about $5. Additionally, some American debit cards may not work in certain countries, especially those that don't have an EMV chip. It's also important to let your bank know that you'll be abroad and using your ATM card to avoid having your card flagged for fraud.
will I get scammed if I use card not cash?
In the UK, if you bought something that was actually a scam, the credit card company can help clearing the balance if you provides necessary documents.
